meta.name: analyze-project
meta.description: Rigor Analyze / Rigor Audit read-only skill for deep learning research repositories. Use when the user wants to read and understand a repository, inspect model structure and training or inference entrypoints, review configs and insertion points, or flag suspicious implementation patterns without modifying code or running heavy jobs. Do not use for active command execution, broad refactoring, speculative code adaptation, or automatic bug fixing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查深度学习代码库,理清结构与关键入口,标出可疑实现
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接手深度学习研究代码,想先搞清结构与风险点。
copy.tagline_en: Read deep-learning repositories and flag suspicious patterns.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to understand a deep-learning research codebase before making changes.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会以只读方式分析深度学习研究仓库:梳理模型结构、训练与推理入口、配置关系,产出 analysis_outputs 下的 SUMMARY.md、RISKS.md、status.json,不改动仓库代码,也不跑重型任务。
howto.when: 当你想先读懂一个深度学习仓库再动手修改,需要模型结构、训练/推理入口等梳理,或想要只读的插入点与可疑实现提示时。

say.text: 只读分析这个仓库,给我模型结构和训练入口的地图。
看看这个仓库的配置和可疑实现,标出风险点。
我要加个新模块,这个仓库哪些插入点合适?
say.note: 属保守建议,非确认结论

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude does read-only analysis of deep learning repos: maps model structure, training/inference entrypoints and configs, and writes SUMMARY.md, RISKS.md and status.json under analysis_outputs/. It never patches repo code.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to understand a repo before changing it, need a map of model structure and training/inference entrypoints, or want read-only notes on insertion points and suspicious patterns.

say_en.text: Analyze this repo read-only; map its model structure and training entrypoints.
Review this repo's configs and flag suspicious implementation patterns.
Where are good insertion points if I add a new module here?
